Disposition: Rejected XML Async-buffer experiment; established synchronous settings restored.
Reason: Million-row allocation falls but first-row time is slower at both large sizes; 25000-row full scan allocates another 227538 bytes and measures slower. DataTable allocation also increases. No general benefit is established.
